outcome: Bank observations can be explicitly matched to immutable book cash journal lines and reconciled against owner-attested statement balances; cash readiness is conservative and evidenced, never fabricated.
risk: Financial matching identity, evidence immutability, no ledger journal mutation, actor and completed-period boundaries.
next: Complete K-CASH-3 then K-CASH-4A budget schema.

references.purpose: Authoritative matching and 7–day default persisted window.
Completed statement equality and version/evidence contract.
Conservative signed cash source and stale/unknown limits.
Reuse owner controls and live role.

invariants: Only registered bank ledger accounts are matchable
Same-sign, exact net; no invented journal
Source and historic match evidence immutable
No completed period rollback without reviewed owner reopen
No positive budget authority without recent complete statement
No external payments or bank provider call
sequence: Freeze full criteria and execution packet in docs-only plan
Implement source-based matching and stable claims
Add statement complete/reopen and SHA evidence
Expose protected owner/admin screen and drilldown
Full exact-head CI and review, safe merge
acceptance: Owner/ADMIN can view bounded same-bank suggested matches using persisted CashAccount.bankMatchWindowDays (0–30, default 7), exact signed cents and Colorado day difference, with explicit source/date/account display; no suggestion is an automatic posting or approval.

OWNER/ADMIN can atomically confirm a many-to-many BankMatchGroup with at least one bank observation and one journal bank line, same account, same sign, equal nonzero signed sums, live role/version checks, stable account→sorted observation→sorted journal locks and active-partial-unique claims. Concurrent retries and second claims refuse or return stable idempotent identity without partial match.

An explicitly reasoned group void restores claimability and observation status when the matched period is still open; the original group, items, actor and audit evidence remain available. Groups touching completed reconciliations require owner reopening the applicable period first; historical linked journal entries are never edited.

OWNER/ADMIN may ignore only proved duplicate/non-account bank rows with a stated reason; unknown income, unmatched expense, payroll, loan, interest or ambiguous transaction cannot be ignored to make a statement reconcile. Existing expense/receipt/typed source links are provided, not guessed accounting entries.

OWNER can create and complete dated statement reconciliation only with an attested opening book balance, explicit acknowledgement of existing outstanding items, sequential contiguous statement range, verified import-through evidence, bank-observation status completeness, independent bank-observation and matched-journal signed totals and zero-cent difference; no fabricated plugs, and no overlapping/gapped completed ranges.

Completion retains immutable source-linked balance, import, match IDs, date, actor, counts and SHA-256 evidence snapshot; a reasoned OWNER reopen leaves old revision readable, invalidates affected later reconciliations and corresponding cash-readiness labels while preserving earlier source journal/export evidence, then permits ordered re-completion.

Read-only cash eligibility from each registered business bank uses last completed statement ending balance plus only cleared/matched later inflows, subtracts all later journal bank outflows and pre-statement outstanding outflows exactly once, includes only subsequently matched earlier inflows, subtracts unreleased holds, and never treats Stripe clearing, undeposited money, promised rent or personal accounts as spendable cash. Missing/stale evidence, unresolved money, unsupported provider types and negative net display UNKNOWN/BLOCKED rather than a positive green funding claim.

Owner/admin mobile bank-check workspace provides account, unmatched observation/source register, matching suggestions and many-to-many confirmation, reasoned ignore/void, statement date/opening/closing/confirmation, full history/reopen and cash-readiness drilldown. STAFF/CUSTOMER cannot access; ADMIN cannot set owner-only opening/reopen policy, and errors are accessible without leaking private bank evidence.

Pure and disposable PostgreSQL tests prove same-account/sign/date, 1:M/M:1 exact sums, claim concurrency/replay/void, strict ignore, DST cutoff, gap/overlap/ending mismatch/outstanding guard, persisted immutable revision/reopen cascade, cash funding exclusions and permission boundaries; mobile Playwright/axe and full exact-head CI/review are mandatory, with owner/provider real bank evidence acceptance separate.

Update STATUS, work-index, decision log, owner guide, database/backup notes and release acceptance honestly; existing K-CASH-1/2 verified merge must be recorded without implying K-CASH-3 deployment, owner bank selection, external transfers or live account authorization.
